summary: Full backend + frontend test of the Idle Game Automation mobile MVP. All 12 pytest backend tests pass (root, dashboard, games CRUD with cascade, sessions lifecycle/stop/filters, milestones CRUD with ordering, dashboard aggregation). All frontend flows render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport: Dashboard hero/stats/recent_sessions, Games list+detail with config.json viewer and 3 milestones, NEW game form, Sessions tab with 5 filter chips (ALL/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED/ABORTED) + COMPLETE/ABORT actions, New Session screen with game picker + presets 15/30/45/60/90m + notes. Theme + navigation working. No red screens, no console errors (only RN deprecation warning about props.pointerEvents).

issues: No testID attributes on TouchableOpacity/TextInput/Tab buttons; testing has to rely on visible text + coordinates which is fragile. Recommend adding testID to bottom tabs, game cards, NEW button, filter chips, preset buttons, LAUNCH/SAVE/DELETE buttons, and TextInputs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - non-blocking but should be migrated.

action_items: Add testID props to all interactive elements (tabs, buttons, inputs, cards, chips) for stable automated testing.
Migrate FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') to lifespan context manager (deprecated in modern FastAPI).
Backend uses Pydantic v1 .dict() calls - works but consider model_dump() for forward compat.
Fix RN web warning by moving pointerEvents from prop to style.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (472 lines) is fine size-wise but could be split into routers (games/sessions/milestones/dashboard/seed) for maintainability.
Good: all Mongo reads project {_id: 0}; helper _clean() exists but unused (dead code).
Good: cascade delete on game removes sessions+milestones.
Good: PATCH session auto-sets ended_at for terminal states (completed/failed/aborted).
seed_data_creation: None created. Backend auto-seeds 2 games + 6 milestones on first boot; tests create/delete TEST_ prefixed data and clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend external URL: https://miner-farm.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env). Bottom tab labels render via CSS text-transform: uppercase, so Playwright get_by_text('Games', exact=True) fails - use coordinate clicks (Dash≈x=65, Games≈x=195, Sessions≈x=325 at y=810) or add testIDs. There is 1 pre-existing 'running' session in DB from prior smoke test.
